steps.title: Set up Basic HTML Structure
steps.description: Create the fundamental index.html file with a responsive viewport and include Tailwind CSS via CDN.

steps.title: Integrate Tailwind CSS
steps.description: Add the Tailwind CSS v4 CDN to index.html for modern styling.

steps.title: Define Application Metadata
steps.description: Create app-meta.json with the application name and project type.

steps.title: Create Age Calculator UI
steps.description: Design the main layout for the age calculator, including a title and a container for input and output.

steps.title: Add Date Input Field
steps.description: Include an HTML date input element for the user to select their birth date.

steps.title: Implement Calculate Button
steps.description: Add a button that triggers the age calculation when clicked.

steps.title: Create Result Display Area
steps.description: Set up a designated area to display the calculated age (years, months, days).

steps.title: Link JavaScript File
steps.description: Connect script.js to index.html to handle dynamic functionality.

steps.title: Initialize JavaScript Logic
steps.description: Set up basic event listeners and get references to UI elements in script.js.

steps.title: Implement Age Calculation Function
steps.description: Write the core logic in JavaScript to calculate age based on birth date and current date.

steps.title: Handle Date Input and Calculation Trigger
steps.description: Add an event listener to the calculate button to fetch the birth date and perform calculation.

steps.title: Display Calculated Age
steps.description: Update the result display area with the calculated years, months, and days.

steps.title: Add Form Validation (Basic)
steps.description: Ensure a birth date is selected before attempting to calculate the age.

steps.title: Apply Base Styling with Tailwind
steps.description: Use Tailwind CSS classes to style the body, container, input fields, and buttons for a clean look.

steps.title: Style Result Display
steps.description: Ensure the calculated age is displayed clearly and prominently.

steps.title: Ensure Responsive Design
steps.description: Utilize Tailwind's responsive utilities to make the app look good on different screen sizes.

steps.title: Configure api_schema.json for No Backend
steps.description: Declare that the application does not require a backend as all logic is client-side.

steps.title: Building agecalculator
steps.description: Final assembly and verification of all components for the Age Calculator web app.
